# EzMiniCactpotSolver [![Download count](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://qzysathwfhebdai6xgauhz4q7m0mzmrf.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/MiniCactpotSolver)](https://github.com/Etheirys/EzMiniCactpot) ![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Etheirys/EzMiniCactpot?style=flat) ![Bluesky followers](https://img.shields.io/bluesky/followers/minmoose.bsky.social?style=flat&label=bluesky%20followers) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1198316676865867776)


This is a Dalamud plugin that highlights the best choices on your Mini Cactpot ticket!

![image](https://github.com/Etheirys/EzMiniCactpot/blob/3f4ca136a6f662f74321e8bec6f129222c242bb3/res/demo_tiles.png)
